lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: I was walking home when I saw a birthday cake.

translation.vi: Tôi đang đi bộ về nhà thì tôi thấy một chiếc bánh sinh nhật.

lines.visual_cue: birthday cake in a shop window

translation.vi: Nó có phải cho bữa tiệc của bạn không?

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: No, today is my sister's birthday.

translation.vi: Không, hôm nay là sinh nhật của em gái tôi.

gloss.en: the day every year when a person has a party and cake
a fun time with friends, food and music

grammar_notes: Use 'was/were + verb-ing' with 'when' to show what was happening when another action happened.
interaction_prompts: What was the last birthday party you enjoyed?
